why: No production message can supply this case: zero of 10,413 messages sit on any of the 992 cut-off stamps, so the data cannot arbitrate whether the interval is open or closed at its lower bound. The rule is (prev, this] -- strict lower, closed upper -- and it is ratified rather than measured (DM-Q18). This fixture is what pins it, and it is mandatory rather than optional for that reason.
pins: RI-2. A message stamped EXACTLY on a shared cut-off belongs to the EARLIER issue, and to exactly one. Reusing CriteriaHelper.between(), which is >= and <=, would place it in both.
